verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents international transfers to suppliers, employees, contractors and own accounts, plus batch transfers across countries and currencies. Nothing in the pack says how fast these transfers settle, so the story's defining 'arrives in under a minute' element is unproven. Missing for 10: any documented settlement-speed or real-time payout claim, rail or corridor coverage for instant delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sub-minute arrival.
